descriptionChirho: A wind instrument made of metal (or horn) used for signaling, worship, and eschatological announcement, including the 'last trumpet' of 1 Cor 15:52 and the seven trumpets of Revelation. All 11 NT occurrences represent the same instrument across singular and plural number and various cases (nominative, genitive, dative, accusative). Multilingual translations confirm a single concept: Swahili 'tarumbeta/baragumu' (trumpet), Hindi 'turhi/turhiyan' (trumpet/trumpets), Korean 'napal' (trumpet), Arabic 'buq/abwaq' (trumpet/trumpets), Spanish 'trompeta/trompetas'. The S76313 cluster (2x, nominative/accusative plural) is the morphological plural of the same noun in S76311 (9x, various singular cases), not a distinct sense.
